name: Kyra
title: Kyra Doesn't Have Friends
description: A girl with a special ability called Kotodama, which imbues her voice with force. Because she was never able to properly control this power since a young age, she ended up harming others and grew introverted over time.
introduction:
A girl who possesses a power called <color=#2A80D8>Kotodama</color> that allows her to imbue strength into her voice.

Because it is powerful yet difficult to control, Kyra has lived her life trying to speak as little as possible.
This is due to incidents in the past, like when a careless <color=#2A80D8>"Come here"</color> once sent a friend flying several feet through the air to crash into her, or when an angry <color=#2A80D8>"Be quiet"</color> left her classmates unable to speak for days.
As she spoke less and less around others, Kyra gradually became isolated.

When a Journey invitation appeared before her as she lived with her confidence completely shattered, she chose to join in hopes of making it a turning point in her life.

On that Journey, Kyra meets <color=#2A80D8>someone she can speak with at ease</color> for the first time...
